mapper.sql: select d.dimension_id, d.dimension_name, d.dimension_code, d.datasource_id, d.source_table_id, d.source_table_name, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark, s.source_name as datasource_name from dp_dimension_table d left join dp_datasource s on s.datasource_id = d.datasource_id
mapper.select: select dimension_id, dimension_name, dimension_code, datasource_id, source_table_id, source_table_name, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, null as datasource_name from dp_dimension_table where dimension_code = #{dimensionCode}

select dimension_id, dimension_name, dimension_code, datasource_id, source_table_id, source_table_name, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, null as datasource_name from dp_dimension_table where datasource_id = #{param1} and source_table_id = #{param2}
mapper.update: update dp_dimension_table set dimension_name = #{dimensionName}, dimension_code = #{dimensionCode}, source_table_name = #{sourceTableName}, status = '0', del_flag = '0', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where dimension_id = #{dimensionId}
update dp_dimension_table set status = #{param2}, update_time = sysdate() where dimension_id = #{param1}
mapper.select: select count(*) from tl_tag_library_dimension where dimension_id = #{dimensionId}
select datasource_id as datasourceId, source_name as sourceName from dp_datasource where status = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by source_name

select t.table_id as tableId, t.object_name as objectName, t.cn_name as cnName, t.object_type as objectType from dp_meta_table t where t.datasource_id = #{datasourceId} and t.status = '0' and t.table_id not in (select source_table_id from dp_dimension_table where del_flag = '0') order by t.object_name
